\section[mīn]{\ml{മീൻ} (mīn) — fish}

\label{lesson:ML-C131-fish}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a feast, then the Malayalam for payasam.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{മീൻ}}
\textbf{\ml{മീൻ}} (\emph{mīn}) — \textquotedblleft{}fish\textquotedblright{}, straight from the boats every morning.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
The coast's favourite food.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{mīn}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{mīn}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{mīn}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a feast, then the Malayalam for payasam, then say \emph{mīn} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{മീൻ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Fish\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
